title: The Scientist Endorsement and the Referral Link
lessons: The player sees AG1 promoting early-career scientists through NIL endorsement deals, a sponsorship model more commonly associated with athletes.
The player already buys AG1 and receives a personal referral link that rewards both the friend and the existing member if the friend makes a first purchase.

text: The player sees AG1 promoting early-career scientists through NIL endorsement deals, a sponsorship model more commonly associated with athletes.

entry-first-1.speaker: AG1
text: I gave NIL endorsement deals to three early-career scientists.

entry-first-2.speaker: PLAYER
text: You say that like I am supposed to know what to do with it.

entry-first-3.speaker: AG1
text: Think college-athlete sponsorship model, except the people I partnered with study sleep, nutrition, and the microbiome.

entry-first-4.speaker: PLAYER
text: And the supplement brand is paying the scientists talking about science.

entry-first-5.speaker: AG1
text: Yes. That is the tension. They are endorsement deals, so you should know they are sponsored before you decide how persuasive they are.

choice-first.speaker: AG1
text: What do you make of that?

choices.text: I like seeing sponsorship money go to scientists.
I still want to separate their research from your endorsement deal.
I do not want sponsored experts selling me supplements.

first-1.speaker: AG1
text: Good. Support the work, read what they actually study, and do not stop at my caption.

first-2.speaker: AG1
text: Good. Sponsorship should change how you read the post.

first-2-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: That is a strange thing for the sponsor to say.

first-2-2.speaker: AG1
text: It would be stranger to pretend the money is invisible.

first-3.speaker: AG1
text: Then do not use the partnership as evidence for the product. That is a reasonable line.
The player already buys AG1 and receives a personal referral link that rewards both the friend and the existing member if the friend makes a first purchase.

entry-return-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: My sister asked me for your link.

entry-return-2.speaker: AG1
text: I have one for that.

entry-return-3.speaker: PLAYER
text: Of course you do.

entry-return-4.speaker: AG1
text: She can get fifteen dollars off plus the referral offer, and you get fifteen dollars after she buys.

entry-return-5.speaker: PLAYER
text: So my recommendation comes with store credit.

entry-return-6.speaker: AG1
text: Yes. If that makes it feel weird, send her the normal link.

choice-return.speaker: AG1
text: What do you make of that?

choices.text: My sister already asked what I use. I could send it to her.
I do not love getting rewarded for a friend's purchase.
I do not want to turn my friends into customers for you.

return-1.speaker: AG1
text: Then send it without a sales speech. She can decide whether the offer is useful.

return-2.speaker: AG1
text: Fair. The credit changes the recommendation, even if you already liked the product.

return-3.speaker: AG1
text: Then do not use the referral link. You do not owe me a sales network.
